''This is capped at 0.6 seconds.''}}|attack speed}} |customlabel = Attack Missile Speed |custominfo = 2500 |targeting = Auto |affects = Self |damagetype = |spellshield = |spelleffects = |projectile = |parry = |notes = * Her attack commands during this time are switched to movement commands instead. Upon finishing the charge and if an attack command was issued, '''Kai'Sa''' will continue walking toward her target. ** '''Kai'Sa''' behaves normally if attack move click was issued not on a target during the cast time, stopping at attack range of the closest target and starts attacking when charged up. |tips = * If ''Supercharge's'' cast time finished while its buff is still active, the movement speed buff lingers briefly longer. ** This is only possible with a significantly high amount of {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}} and {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}. |yvideo = K2JwZhvTni8 }}

R.name: Killer Instinct
R.title: Template:Data Kai'Sa/Killer Instinct
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Killer Instinct|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kai'Sa
|skill        = R
|icon         = Killer Instinct.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kai'Sa}} briefly {{tip|shields}} herself and {{tip|dashes}} near an enemy champion affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a target location near a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion that was {{tt|affected|Stack application or consumption}} by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} within the last 4 seconds. The shield's duration is refreshed when the dash ends.
|leveling     = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90 to 180}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
|description2 = ''An enemy champion within range and affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Killer Instinct {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attack timer. '''Kai'Sa''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''
|target range = {{ap|2000 to 3000}}
|effect radius= {{tt|525|Area around enemy champions}}
|speed        = {{tt|3800|estimated}}
|cost         = 100
|cast time = none
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|130 to 70}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = 
|parry        = 
|grounded     = true
|knockdown    = true
|outofrange   = false
|notes        = 
* '''Kai'Sa''' will issue a movement command to the targeted location regardless of whether the target location is valid. The dash is not buffered during this movement command. '''Kai'Sa''' will not dash if the targeted location becomes valid by walking in range or a nearby enemy champion becomes affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
** If the targeted location is not valid, the range indicator will glow.
* The enemy champion recently affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} must be in range of '''Kai'Sa''' for the targeted location to be valid, and not the targeted location itself.
|yvideo       = leoPEymrxt0
}}
